Jordan
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Amman, Jordan.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visas are issued at the entry or in Rome):
Regular passport YES Visas are issued at the entry
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Holders of diplomatic and official passports of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit ,transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
